rules.seeding: Seeds 1–5 go to the best records, with points for as the tiebreaker. Seed 6 goes to the highest-scoring team among the other seven.
rules.bracket: Six teams, reseeded every round (Commissioner's Playbook 2026-27): 4 v 5 and 3 v 6 in Week 15; in Week 16 seed 1 plays the lowest seed still alive and seed 2 plays the other winner; championship in Week 17.
rules.bracket_flag: Sleeper itself is still set to a fixed bracket, as it was in 2025. If the 6 seed wins in Week 15, Sleeper will show different Week 16 pairings from the Playbook rule unless the setting is changed.
rules.draft: Commissioner's Playbook 2026-27: the six non-playoff teams pick 1–6 in reverse order of regular-season finish, and the six playoff teams pick 7–12 in reverse order of playoff finish. The 6 seed can never receive a top-six pick.
rules.draft_flag: Projected slots are simulated; the order is only final when the season ends.
rules.model: Probabilities come from 8,000 simulated finishes of the regular season. Each team's weekly score is drawn from a bell curve centred on 70% of its season average plus 30% of its last three weeks, with spread taken from its own week-to-week variation (never less than 18 points).
